<p class="note-meta">Gradient estimation</p>

### [Reparameterization gradients](writing/reparameterization-gradients.qmd)

The parameter of interest appears inside a sampling distribution. Two unbiased estimators expose why a change of variables can reduce gradient variance.
:::

::: {.note-card}
<p class="note-meta">Statistical estimation</p>

### [Why optimize log likelihood?](writing/log-likelihood.qmd)

A likelihood product and its log have the same maximizer. The logarithm gives additive derivatives and stable numerical computation.
:::
:::
